snippet.title: Grey Hulk (2027) - Matt Damon, Anthony Hopkins, Angelina Jolie, Keanu Reeves | Concept Trailer
snippet.description:
#GreyHulk #MattDamon #AnthonyHopkins #AngelinaJolie #KeanuReeves #Kluh

Jack Morrow — a former combat medic wrongfully convicted of treason and buried in a black-site prison called Ashworth Federal Penitentiary — has spent six years rotting in a concrete cell with no trial, no appeal, and no hope, until a shadowy government operative named Director Elias Hargrove arrives with an offer: survive a classified experimental serum injection under a program called Project Goliath, and walk out a free man with a full pardon and a new identity. Desperate and with nothing left to lose, Morrow signs the document and is transported to Site Prometheus — a massive underground research facility hidden beneath the Utah salt flats — where lead geneticist Dr. Lena Vasik injects him with a dark silvery-green gamma serum that has already killed thirty-one previous test subjects, but this time something different happens: Morrow doesn't die — his veins turn black, his skin shifts to dark stone-grey, his hair falls away leaving a bald skull mapped with pulsing veins, and he transforms into something the military never imagined — the Grey Hulk, the first successful survivor of Project Goliath, stronger and smarter than anything they've ever created. But when Morrow discovers that the freedom he was promised was a lie — that the documents he signed were consent-to-terminate forms and every test subject was scheduled for disposal regardless of survival — he makes a decision: he's not their weapon, he's not their experiment, and he's not dying in this facility, igniting a brutal breakout through the underground corridors of Site Prometheus, a jungle warfare campaign against an entire military task force sent to hunt him down, and a final desperate airstrike that fails to stop something that was never meant to be stopped. With the help of Dr. Vasik — who risks everything to expose the truth about Section 9's crimes — Grey Hulk escapes into the wilderness, but Hargrove is already planning Phase 2 with two hundred new subjects, and deep in the wreckage of the destroyed facility, something else is waking up — Roman Volkov, the man Grey Hulk left for dead, is transforming into something darker, something more savage, something called KLUH.
Matt Damon as Jack Morrow / Grey Hulk
Anthony Hopkins as Director Elias Hargrove
Angelina Jolie as Dr. Lena Vasik
Keanu Reeves as Roman Volkov / Kluh

snippet.title: KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS Official Trailer
snippet.description:
KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS in cinemas worldwide with limited screenings from August 12. 
tickets now on sale at http://katseyewildheartsfilm.com/

Two-time GRAMMY®-nominated global girl group KATSEYE is coming to cinemas worldwide with a special theatrical release ahead of their third EP, WILD.

KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS is a captivating journey into the group's bold new era while celebrating the fans who helped make it possible. Featuring never-before-seen footage, EYEKONS fan videos, and intimate interviews from the group members, the film explores the powerful bond between KATSEYE and their global fandom. A love letter to the EYEKONS who helped build this movement, KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS reveals why this group's story is only just beginning.

From the intense pressure of Dream Academy to chart-topping viral success, audiences experience the highs, setbacks, sacrifices, and breakthrough moments that transformed KATSEYE on their path to global pop stardom. Praised by outlets including The New York Times, Vogue, Rolling Stone, and Billboard, KATSEYE has earned acclaim for their relentless dedication to their craft and electrifying live performances. As one of pop's most exciting emerging global acts, the group continues to solidify its place as a worldwide force.

From the same team that created Netflix’s POP STAR ACADEMY, KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS is produced by Interscope Films and Boardwalk Pictures, in partnership with HYBE X GEFFEN, and directed by Nadia Hallgren.

The result is the ultimate underdog story behind the ultimate underdog movie.

snippet.title: FATAL FURY: CotW ｜ Season 3 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
City of the Wolves is Destined for Revenge in Season 3.
New fighter and content update every month from July 23!
-------------------------------
Destined for Revenge in Season 3.
City of the Wolves continues its evolution with monthly updates. New characters, new stages, new fervor, new fury!
 
Destined for Revenge replaces the previous overarching theme (Season 2's Legends Unleashed) as even more fighters—and their vengeance-fueled fates—descend upon South Town's sinister streets. Monthly DLC updates will help shape the competitive landscape as City of the Wolves pushes new boundaries for its player base going forward.
Season 3 will add the following DLC characters to the playable roster, with mystery fighters slated for release in October and December. Further details will be revealed in due course.
 
Season 3 Character Lineup  
- Rick Strowd (July 23, 2026)
- Duck King (August 2026)
- Kim Kaphwan (September 2026)
- Mystery character (October 2026)
- Laocorn (November 2026)
- Mystery character (December 2026)

・Price: $49.99/€49.99

snippet.title: The Odyssey Backlash - It's Nolan's Colon Time!
snippet.description:
We need to go deeper to discover the inner working of Christopher Nolan so James & Maso are doing just that in this brand new segment on The Weekly Planet podcast. Going into the YouTube dislikes on The Odyssey trailers, the casting backlash and more. You can also check out even more of "Nolan's Colon" in the full segment on the podcast which covers Christopher Nolan's thoughts on a Blue Thunder remake & Quentin Tarantino's 10 film rule. Then next week it's the BIG MOVIE review for The Odyssey which looks to be doing well on Rotten Tomatoes already. In the meantime, thanks for watching Nolan's Colon everybody!

From your head to your toes, out of control, baby you know

With me and you, it's whatever girl, hey! (Ooh)  
So can we make this thing ours?  

You should let me love you (you should let me love you)  
Let me be the one to (let me be the one to give)  
Give you everything you want and need (everything you need, yeah)

Naval warfare has arrived, bringing all-out combat across land, air, and sea. 

Deploy to Tsuru Reef, our biggest battlefield yet, where sprawling islands, dynamic waves, boats, jets, helicopters, and ground vehicles collide in massive battles. Command the coastline with the RCB-90 Patrol Boat or race through the surf in the 7.7m NSW RHIB.

Prepare to deploy when Season 4 launches on July 21.

snippet.title: Meet Exfauxdia: My TCG-Locked Hardcore Ironman (Cardcore Ep. 1)
snippet.description:
Limited Edition OSRS PC, Keyboard, Wall-Art, Mousepad and Case at https://starforgepc.com/Faux

Exfauxdia Cardcore: The rules are not a perfect science since this is so new. I'll be using logic and reason to mould these as we go, and will sometimes leave the decision up to the chat for fairness sake when I see fit.


- Earn credits by gaining experience, leveling, or killing NPCs
- Spend credits to open card packs (2500 credits per pack)
- CAN only use items that you have a card for
- CAN only attack NPCs that you have a card for
- CAN speak to NPCs that you don't have a card for
- CANNOT attack NPCs that you don't have a card for
- Mistakes will happen, but will require a reasonable punish ment agreed upon by chat
- Quests require all required items to be unlocked. If an NPC fight occurs, must have that NPC unlocked if the card exists
- Content that doesn't have an associated card is assumed unlocked


- FOIL Cards unlocks: Foil cards are rare enough that they should be exciting, anticipated, and feel rewarding.
 - Foil item unlocks all items including and BELOW that card tier (example: Foil mith axe also unlocks bronze-black axe, but not addy+)
 - Foil boss unlocks all unique collection logs of that boss (example: Foil General Graardor unlocks all Bandos armor, Bandos hilt, shards)
 - Foil items on a case by case basis unlock horizontally instead of vertically (Foil god d'hide shield unlocks other god d'hide shields, but not all tiers below)
